mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 0.5% signals a tightening monetary policy that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 0.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 5.0% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to delay rate cuts and suppressing equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is below 5.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction permits above 1.15 million units signals strong housing demand and rising consumer confidence, which drives equity market optimism and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST exceeds 1150.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 105.0 index level signals weakening manufacturing activity and economic contraction, which increases recession risk and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 105.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in both residential construction permits and real personal consumption expenditures signal a broad-based demand surge that boosts corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS rise, or the interaction Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising inflation (CPIAUCSL > 238.0) and a stable federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.3%) signals disinflationary policy inertia, which increases real interest rate uncertainty and suppresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 238.0 and FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.3%, or the interaction Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment above 143,000 thousand, combined with a declining unemployment rate, signals strong labor market momentum that increases inflationary pressure and triggers preemptive monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS > 143000 and UNRATE < 5.1%, or the interaction Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained expansion in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS > 445,000 million) combined with a rising GDP growth rate (GDPC1 > 16,400 billion) signals robust aggregate demand, which strengthens corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where both RSAFS > 445,000 and GDPC1 > 16,400, or the interaction Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.
